claims: Artemis is NASA’s ongoing space program.
The Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon, including the first woman and person of color, for long-term exploration and to prepare for Mars.
The Artemis program uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis program uses the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis missions are focused on the lunar South Pole.
The Artemis program fosters commercial/international partnerships.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled for 2026.
The Artemis II mission is currently underway.
The Artemis II mission represents the first crewed flight.
The Artemis II mission sends four astronauts on a ~10-day mission around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II mission verifies systems.
Future missions following Artemis II aim to land on the Moon's South Pole to investigate water ice.
Future missions following Artemis II aim to establish a long-term presence.
Artemis V is anticipated to begin building a lunar base around 2028.
The Artemis program is named after the Greek goddess of the Moon.
The Greek goddess of the Moon is the twin sister of Apollo.
An International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) review service is named Artemis.
A European Southern Observatory camera is named Artemis.
